description: This file defines a Java class 'AvroMonthDayMapper' that provides a method to convert a java.time.MonthDay object to its string representation. It is part of the package related to serialization mappers in the Fineract project.

classes.name: AvroMonthDayMapper
classes.description: A component class that maps MonthDay objects to strings for serialization purposes.

methods.name: mapMonthDay
methods.description: Converts a MonthDay object to its string representation, or returns null if the input is null.
